title: Corn, twenty-nine
logline: September 12, 2026. The corn on the long table, and this time a hand beside it, and the boxes behind. A month before the editor. The tray and the hand and the wall of numbered lids.

panels.composition: The long table: the corn tray, a hand resting flat beside it — older, a scar on the knuckle from a mat cutter in 2004 — and behind, out of focus, the wall of numbered boxes, 1 to 40. Twenty-nine years. The hand is the first time the anniversary page has any of him in it.

characters.pose: a hand flat on the table

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a drafting table with a paper tray of buttered corn and a man's older hand resting flat beside it with a small scar on one knuckle, a wall of numbered cardboard boxes out of focus behind, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Twenty-nine. A hand, this time. The boxes behind.
